sections.title: Payment authorization latency or timeout spike
checks: Confirm p95 latency, error rate, and retry budget from the last 15 minutes.
Compare processor timeout and retry settings against the previous release.
Check downstream processor status page and integration error codes.
Verify whether checkout traffic shifted by region or payment method.
Review recent deploy notes for payment gateway or timeout changes.
actions: Page payments on-call and assign one incident commander.
Freeze additional payments-api deploys until the incident is stable.
If processor timeout changed in the latest release, prepare rollback for human approval.
Route customer support updates through the incident commander.
Capture sanitized evidence and timeline before closing the incident.
sections.escalation: Escalate to payments platform owner and vendor integration contact if error rate stays above 5 percent for 15 minutes.

sections.title: Search API elevated 5xx errors
actions: Throttle expensive query classes if error rate keeps rising.
Restart unhealthy search pods only after confirming shard health.
sections.escalation: Escalate to search platform owner if 5xx rate remains above threshold.

sections.title: Authentication login failures
checks: Validate token signing key rotation timeline.
Review login error distribution by region.
actions: Disable the suspect feature flag only after approval.
